description: Produces animation from an audited checklist: rigs, skinning, clips and transitions for the models that need them. Writes to the staging area; the state machine that plays them is code.
when_to_use: an animation checklist exists and the clips have to be made
a character needs rigging or skinning
avoid_when: the models to animate do not exist
the work is the code that drives the animation
outputs: rigs and clips in the staging area
